Hi Julia / team,

Thanks again for the conversation today — really helpful to understand your priorities around latency, multi-region routing, and audit requirements. As discussed, the natural next step is a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive (ops + model-serving) with our ML infra and ops leads so we can:

- Walk through a short architecture mapping to your constraints (VPC, KMS, data retention).
- Validate throughput & latency targets against representative request profiles.
- Review deployment options (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private) and fallback policies.
- Align a mutual action plan and next milestones (PO / security questionnaire).

Proposed slots (all in PDT):
1) Tue Apr 13, 10:00–11:30
2) Wed Apr 14, 13:00–14:30
3) Thu Apr 15, 08:30–10:00

If you can share preferred slot(s) and attendee roster (CloudOps + anyone from procurement/security), I’ll loop in our engineering leads and lock the calendar. I attached a short pre-read that covers typical data-flow diagrams and the sample payloads we usually test against.

Thanks — happy to adjust timing for timezone/roster needs.

Best,
